name: Xiaoli Zhang
title: Professor; Robotics Program Director
fitReason: Very strong CS/embodied-AI fit: current research combines VLM intent inference, VLA policy uncertainty and human authority allocation for physical manipulation. A focused model-calibration or shared-autonomy project is more relevant than the lab’s separate materials/manufacturing research.

physicalEvidence.summary: The September 21, 2026 primary shared-control paper specifies a physical six-joint LeRobot SO-101, Joy-Con teleoperation and RGB cameras. It evaluates Moondream3/SmolVLA-based assistance in pick-and-place and stacking with 12 participants; 400 demonstrations train the models.

shortVisit.summary: No current lab-specific external-master’s summer or visitor invitation was verified. Mines does have an institutional unpaid Contingent Visiting Scholar category explicitly covering external graduate students, and its J-1 funding page permits personal/family funding. This is an administrative possibility only; no host, eight-week schedule, funding or summer 2027 place is confirmed.

scoreReasons.fit: direct VLM/VLA, uncertainty and human-robot shared autonomy.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: institution-level pathway but no lab invitation.
scoreReasons.freshness: September 2026 primary paper and verified 2026 promotion.

name: Weitian Wang
title: Professor; Founder Director of Collaborative Robotics and Smart Systems Laboratory
fitReason: Strong AI-method overlap with learning from demonstrations, deep Q-learning, natural-language robot teaching and multimodal human-intent inference in physical collaborative manipulation.

physicalEvidence.summary: The official university record of his August 2025 DQN collaborative-learning paper reports real-world robot implementation and a user study. His coauthored ASME MCROS report specifies two UR10e arms on an all-terrain mobile base with multimodal sensors and actual application trials. The exact arm used in the separate DQN study was not verified from full paper text.

shortVisit.summary: The full lab openings page advertises degree-seeking PhD positions beginning Spring/Fall 2025, not short visits. A 2024 university REU listing includes Wang but restricts eligibility to US citizens/permanent residents who are undergraduates; it is not suitable evidence for this external master’s profile. No lab-specific summer 2027 visitor opening or funding verified.

scoreReasons.fit: direct embodied learning and physical collaboration.
scoreReasons.physical: recent real-world DQN study plus named lab hardware, but exact experimental platform not checked in full DQN paper.
scoreReasons.freshness: lab lists 2026 ICRA, speech-vision action planning and hand-tracking papers.
